items.title: Harrison Verrett Interview, 1961-08-10
items.q: I played Rene but never played Buddy Petit. I played Rene band.

ctx.x: Did you ever play with any of those bands like Buddy Petit or Rene?

I played Rene but never played Buddy Petit. I played Rene band. He played it many times, on the wagons, you know, he's had wagons for advertising and advertising, you know? Many of them, we played. That used to be regular. It's not no more. In those days, you'd run a band here and about three blocks up, another band on the truck and four blocks over here bands on the truck and that's where it was. Music all in the streets.
And how did you play, I guess you played banjo with them. How did you play your banjo with them? Is there any different to the way you play with these bands now?
